description: Declares an external API (domain, authentication without a secret, callers), to be accepted; a person enters the secret in while.

apps.description: Calling services and tasks (web, task:charger); by default, those of the while.yaml that declare it.

authentication.description: Recipe, no secret: header {name, prefix}; parameter {name}; oauth2 {token_url|issuer, scope, client_auth basic|body, header}; session {login_url, token_field, duration_seconds}; jwt {mode exchange|client_assertion|direct, token_url|issuer, alg RS256|ES256, duration_s, claims {iss, aud, scope, sub}, client_id, scope}, signed by while; model google {client_email, scopes}, salesforce {client_id, sub}, microsoft {tenant_id, client_id, scope, x5t}; federated: google {project_number, pool, provider, scopes, service_account?}, azure {tenant, client_id, scope}, generic {exchange_url}.

model.description: The provider, for model or federated.

direction.description: The apps will also write (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).

model.description: An AI or Snowflake (account, user, role, warehouse): domain and recipe set automatically.

owner.description: Email of the owner; by default, the signed-in user.

project.description: The project of the calling apps; by default, the token's.

read.description: Patterns read with POST (a search, a GraphQL query): /api/v1/searches.

reads.description: all, except refused_paths; listed: those in rules.

rules.description: Its writes, and its reads if reads: listed. Federated: required. A POST that reads: its pattern in read too.

approve_each_call.description: true: each call waits to be accepted.

update.description: An existing connection: read becomes the wanted list; removing applies at once, adding goes through a request.

name: declare_connection
title: Declare a connection
